pass_condition: Record reviewer/checker identity, immutable claim/proof version, exact scope, concrete findings and unresolved premises. A novelty claim also needs a specific primary-source comparison; no aggregate internal-agent count or integrity receipt substitutes for it.
priority_rationale: All current scientific leads retain unverified external correctness/priority; this gate is universal and does not rank fields by expected breakthrough.
question: Which surviving candidates withstand independent source-level criticism and precise prior-art comparison?
title: Obtain independent exact-contract correctness and priority review
validation_boundary: No gate is closed by indexing, agreement, finite diagnostics, or a newer timestamp; this is a routing decision, not predicted breakthrough value.
